lines: Lose the service mid-race, and Telo Ride rides on. The bike, the plan and the clock never stop.
The board keeps its last standings, and a quiet notice says they will catch up.
A group class does the same: the video rolls on, the board holds, and the notice explains why.
When the service is back, the ride reconnects, takes its seat again, and the notice goes.
On rejoining, the service sends the standings to that rider at once, so the board catches up within a second.
The notice on the race, from a phone to the full screen.
What the tests prove: the ride carries on, the notice shows and goes, and the board updates on rejoining.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
